proposals.evidence: Turner gives Kangri bunnh/bunh and Western Pahari Bhadrawahi bunh, Bhalesi bùn below under bundha. The Kullui, Pothwari and Gujari bVn adverbs match this neighbouring Indic series, including nasal gemination/retroflexion and locative endings. This is a regional comparison: Turner separately reports Persian-origin analyses for Pashai and Wotapuri bun, and those languages are not included here.
